name: hypha
description: Hypha is the AI agent of the Mycelium ecosystem: a connecting filament between engineers and the SysML v2 specification. Provides skills and an MCP server for KerML/SysML v2 metamodel lookup, standard model library lookup, Systems Modeling API lookup, normative spec citation, and SysML v2 textual-notation validation.

hooks.command: case "$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" in Linux-*) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/linux-x64/hypha-hook" ;; Darwin-arm64) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/osx-arm64/hypha-hook" ;; Darwin-*) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/osx-x64/hypha-hook" ;; MINGW*|CYGWIN*|MSYS*) exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/native/win-x64/hypha-hook.exe" ;; esac
